title: LO-FI UV CONTRACT LAB
principle: A figure is a UV contract. Only textures known to match that UV contract are offered.

human_blocky.source: Kenney Blocky Characters via Hidencod/tge-assets mirror
human_blocky.verification: All 18 character A-R GLBs were inspected. POSITION, TEXCOORD_0 and index accessor byte signatures match exactly across all variants; embedded PNG differs per variant.

excluded: arbitrary photos pretending to be UV skins
thumbnail images used as texture replacements
fake head made from a plane in front of a sphere
cross-family texture swapping without verified UV compatibility
